verdicts.quote: Default to one reminder per eligible invoice over its lifetime. Eligibility requires ... a current cutoff strictly earlier than the evaluation instant
Partially paid invoices with a remaining balance qualify. Draft, paid, void, canceled, deleted and collection-held invoices are ineligible.
verdicts.missing: Treatment of credited and disputed invoices is left as an open gap ("collectible status mapping (including credits, disputes and holds)"); payment plans are not addressed.

verdicts.quote: states the current outstanding amount and currency
The billing owner must confirm channel, sender, contact selection for multiple contacts, required content, contact permissions or exclusions
verdicts.missing: How do-not-contact, paused or unsubscribed customer states suppress reminders, and whether a billing notice is exempt from a marketing opt-out.

verdicts.quote: One confirmed acceptance consumes the reminder for that scoped invoice. Concurrent evaluations, retries after acceptance, restart and later invoice edits produce no additional accepted submission.
Immediately before each submission, including a retry, use current invoice facts, contact and enabled scope... A payment ... effective by the final authority check suppresses the submission.
Confirmed permanent failure or exhausted retry allowance ends automatic attempts and exposes an actionable outcome.
verdicts.missing: Retry intervals and the retry budget are left open (R-3 Open gaps), and the spec does not say how a provider outage is handled or who is alerted.

verdicts.quote: At the selected runtime and authorized provider quota, excess work stays recoverable and visible to operators... Evaluation interval, dispatch-lag target, workload, concurrency, retry and cost bounds remain open.
verdicts.missing: The provider rate limit, and how a large batch is paced within it.

verdicts.quote: The billing owner must identify the approved sender scope and rollout cohort, including whether to enable existing overdue invoices.
verdicts.missing: Whether the backlog of already-overdue invoices is throttled or staggered rather than sent all at once on enablement.

verdicts.quote: The billing owner must confirm cutoff semantics for date-only invoices and time zones
verdicts.missing: Time-zone handling for the cutoff, and whether sends are limited to the customer's local business hours or avoid weekends and holidays.

verdicts.quote: states the current outstanding amount and currency
verdicts.missing: How the amount and currency are formatted for the recipient's locale.

verdicts.quote: If there is no valid authorized contact, submit nothing, record the reason and allow future evaluation after correction. Never substitute an unverified recipient.
The billing owner must confirm channel, sender, contact selection for multiple contacts
verdicts.missing: Which of several billing contacts receives the reminder.

verdicts.quote: Durable reminder state may retain scoped identifiers, attempt references, status, reason codes and timestamps needed for recovery and read-back.
verdicts.missing: Whether the record shows what was sent and whether it appears on the invoice; the operator surface is still unidentified and message content is excluded.

verdicts.quote: It identifies the sender and invoice, states the current outstanding amount and currency, and directs the recipient to the existing authorized invoice or payment route when available.
verdicts.missing: Whether the due date is included, and whether the payment link expires.

verdicts.quote: Authorized account configuration determines the enabled scope... No new identity, shared workspace, settings page, or manual send control is required.
verdicts.missing: Which roles may configure or enable reminders and who may stop a reminder by hand; "authorized" is not defined.

verdicts.quote: Disabling the approved scope stops new attempts at the next final check, including during recovery.
verdicts.missing: A per-customer off switch, preview or dry-run, and manual resend; manual send control is explicitly not provided.

verdicts.quote: Authorized billing operators can distinguish ineligible or suppressed, pending, retryable, unresolved, accepted and ended without acceptance.
The billing and runtime owners must agree retry intervals, finite budget, maximum reminder age
verdicts.missing: The actual cap on sending volume and the maximum lateness or age of a reminder.

verdicts.quote: Original invoice and payment workflows retain their authority and behavior.
